message.content:
**Uno – Game Rules (Official)** *(Based on the official Uno® rulebook; simplified for quick reference)* --- ### 1. Objective Be the first player to score **500 points**. Points are tallied at the end of each round when a player reaches 0 cards. --- ### 2. Setup | Item | How to Prepare | |------|----------------| | Deck | Standard 108‑card Uno deck (4 colors × 25 cards + 8 Wild cards). | | Players | 2–10 players. | | Deal | Each player draws 7 cards. | | Starting card | Flip the top card of the draw pile onto the discard pile. If it’s a special card (e.g., Draw Two, Reverse, Skip, Wild, or Wild Draw Four), treat it as if it were played by the dealer. | | Turn order | Initially clockwise. Reverse cards change direction. | --- ### 3. Card Types | Color | Card | Value | Effect | |-------|------|-------|--------| | Red/Yellow/Green/Blue | Number (0–9) | Face value | Match by color or number. | | Same colors | Skip | 20 | Next player loses a turn. | | Same colors | Reverse | 20 | Change play direction. | | Same colors | Draw Two | 50 | Next player draws two cards and loses a turn. | | Wild | Wild | 25 | Player chooses new color. | | Wild | Wild Draw Four | 50 | Player chooses new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. *Can only be played if you have no matching color.* | --- ### 4. Gameplay | Phase | What Happens | |-------|--------------| | **Turn** | 1. **Play**: If you have a card that matches the top discard by color, number, or symbol, you may play it. If you play a Wild or Wild Draw Four, you must announce the new color.
2. **Draw**: If you cannot play, draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played immediately, you may do so; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | - **Skip**: Next player loses a turn.
- **Reverse**: Direction changes (clockwise ↔ counter‑clockwise).
- **Draw Two**: Next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
- **Wild**: Choose new color.
- **Wild Draw Four**: Choose new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. | | **UNO Call** | When you have **exactly one card left**, shout “UNO!” before your next opponent takes a turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, the round ends. That player scores points based on the cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards: face value
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two: 20 points each
• Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each | --- ### 5. Scoring | Card | Points | |------|--------| | Number | Face value | | Skip / Reverse / Draw Two | 20 | | Wild / Wild Draw Four | 50 | Add up the points from all opponents’ hands. The winner of the round receives those points. Play continues until someone reaches **500 points** (or a pre‑agreed target). --- ### 6. Common Variations (Optional) | Variation | Rule | |-----------|------| | **Stacking** | Players may stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing. The total penalty accumulates until a player cannot stack. | | **No Wild Draw Four** | Some groups ban Wild Draw Four to keep the game simpler. | | **House Rules** | Many families add house rules such as “draw two on a skip” or “reverse on a wild.” Always agree before starting. | --- ### 7. Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on colors** – If you’re low on cards, try to play a color that matches many opponents’ hands. 2. **Use Wilds strategically** – Save Wild Draw Four for when you’re about to win or when you need to block a strong opponent. 3. **Watch the discard pile** – Knowing what cards have been played helps you anticipate opponents’ moves. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
